comparison.objective: Unfold and configure a laptop stand with two rods in highest slots; candidate separates loose media from retained washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Scissor-linkage deployment and dual rod-slot seating versus lifting and agitating a loaded screen while controlling passage and retention.
comparison.success_condition: Full spread, both rods seated, stand contained, stable and released versus recovery ratio, no washer loss or spill, dual support, release, and 3-second dwell.
comparison.reason: Both use two hands and finish on supports, but linkage configuration does not test selective many-body separation. Missing rubric details: none material in the final spec.
